  468   #=============================================================================
  469   # End Of Round end terrain check
  470   #=============================================================================
  471   def pbEOREndTerrain
  472     # Count down terrain duration
  473     @field.terrainDuration -= 1 if @field.terrainDuration > 0
  474     # Terrain wears off
  475     if @field.terrain != :None && @field.terrainDuration == 0
  476       case @field.terrain
  477       when :Electric
  478         pbDisplay(_INTL("The electric current disappeared from the battlefield!"))
  479       when :Grassy
  480         pbDisplay(_INTL("The grass disappeared from the battlefield!"))
  481       when :Misty
  482         pbDisplay(_INTL("The mist disappeared from the battlefield!"))
  483       when :Psychic
  484         pbDisplay(_INTL("The weirdness disappeared from the battlefield!"))
  485       end
  486       @field.terrain = :None
  487       allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbAbilityOnTerrainChange }
  488       # Start up the default terrain
  489       if @field.defaultTerrain != :None
  490         pbStartTerrain(nil, @field.defaultTerrain, false)
  491         allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbAbilityOnTerrainChange }
  492         allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck }
  493       end
  494       return if @field.terrain == :None
  495     end
  496     # Terrain continues
  497     terrain_data = GameData::BattleTerrain.try_get(@field.terrain)
  498     pbCommonAnimation(terrain_data.animation) if terrain_data
  499     case @field.terrain
  500     when :Electric then pbDisplay(_INTL("An electric current is running across the battlefield."))
  501     when :Grassy   then pbDisplay(_INTL("Grass is covering the battlefield."))
  502     when :Misty    then pbDisplay(_INTL("Mist is swirling about the battlefield."))
  503     when :Psychic  then pbDisplay(_INTL("The battlefield is weird."))
  504     end
  505   end

  507   #=============================================================================
  508   # End Of Round end self-inflicted effects on battler
  509   #=============================================================================
  510   def pbEOREndBattlerSelfEffects(battler)
  511     return if battler.fainted?
  512     # Hyper Mode (Shadow Pokémon)
  513     if battler.inHyperMode?
  514       if pbRandom(100) < 10
  515         battler.pokemon.hyper_mode = false
  516         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} came to its senses!", battler.pbThis))
  517       else
  518         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is in Hyper Mode!", battler.pbThis))
  519       end
  520     end
  521     # Uproar
  522     if battler.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] > 0
  523       battler.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] -= 1
  524       if battler.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] == 0
  525         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} calmed down.", battler.pbThis))
  526       else
  527         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is making an uproar!", battler.pbThis))
  528       end
  529     end
  530     # Slow Start's end message
  531     if battler.effects[PBEffects::SlowStart] > 0
  532       battler.effects[PBEffects::SlowStart] -= 1
  533       if battler.effects[PBEffects::SlowStart] == 0
  534         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} finally got its act together!", battler.pbThis))
  535       end
  536     end
  537   end

  540   # End Of Round shift distant battlers to middle positions
  541   #=============================================================================
  542   def pbEORShiftDistantBattlers
  543     # Move battlers around if none are near to each other
  544     # NOTE: This code assumes each side has a maximum of 3 battlers on it, and
  545     #       is not generalised to larger side sizes.
  546     if !singleBattle?
  547       swaps = []   # Each element is an array of two battler indices to swap
  548       2.times do |side|
  549         next if pbSideSize(side) == 1   # Only battlers on sides of size 2+ need to move
  550         # Check if any battler on this side is near any battler on the other side
  551         anyNear = false
  552         allSameSideBattlers(side).each do |battler|
  553           anyNear = allOtherSideBattlers(battler).any? { |other| nearBattlers?(other.index, battler.index) }
  554           break if anyNear
  555         end
  556         break if anyNear
  557         # No battlers on this side are near any battlers on the other side; try
  558         # to move them
  559         # NOTE: If we get to here (assuming both sides are of size 3 or less),
  560         #       there is definitely only 1 able battler on this side, so we
  561         #       don't need to worry about multiple battlers trying to move into
  562         #       the same position. If you add support for a side of size 4+,
  563         #       this code will need revising to account for that, as well as to
  564         #       add more complex code to ensure battlers will end up near each
  565         #       other.
  566         allSameSideBattlers(side).each do |battler|
  567           # Get the position to move to
  568           pos = -1
  569           case pbSideSize(side)
  570           when 2 then pos = [2, 3, 0, 1][battler.index]   # The unoccupied position
  571           when 3 then pos = (side == 0) ? 2 : 3    # The centre position
  572           end
  573           next if pos < 0
  574           # Can't move if the same trainer doesn't control both positions
  575           idxOwner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(battler.index)
  576           next if pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(pos) != idxOwner
  577           swaps.push([battler.index, pos])
  578         end
  579       end
  580       # Move battlers around
  581       swaps.each do |pair|
  582         next if pbSideSize(pair[0]) == 2 && swaps.length > 1
  583         next if !pbSwapBattlers(pair[0], pair[1])
  584         case pbSideSize(pair[1])
  585         when 2
  586           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} moved across!", @battlers[pair[1]].pbThis))
  587         when 3
  588           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} moved to the center!", @battlers[pair[1]].pbThis))
  589         end
  590       end
  591     end
  592   end

  597   def pbEndOfRoundPhase
  598     PBDebug.log("")
  599     PBDebug.log("[End of round #{@turnCount + 1}]")
  600     @endOfRound = true
  601     @scene.pbBeginEndOfRoundPhase
  602     pbCalculatePriority           # recalculate speeds
  603     priority = pbPriority(true)   # in order of fastest -> slowest speeds only
  604     # Weather
  605     pbEOREndWeather(priority)
  606     # Future Sight/Doom Desire
  607     @positions.each_with_index { |pos, idxPos| pbEORUseFutureSight(pos, idxPos) }
  608     # Wish
  609     pbEORWishHealing
  610     # Sea of Fire damage (Fire Pledge + Grass Pledge combination)
  611     pbEORSeaOfFireDamage(priority)
  612     # Status-curing effects/abilities and HP-healing items
  613     priority.each do |battler|
  614       pbEORTerrainHealing(battler)
  615       # Healer, Hydration, Shed Skin
  616       if battler.abilityActive?
  617         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerEndOfRoundHealing(battler.ability, battler, self)
  618       end
  619       # Black Sludge, Leftovers
  620       if battler.itemActive?
  621         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerEndOfRoundHealing(battler.item, battler, self)
  622       end
  623     end
  624     # Self-curing of status due to affection
  625     if Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @internalBattle
  626       priority.each do |battler|
  627         next if battler.fainted? || battler.status == :NONE
  628         next if !battler.pbOwnedByPlayer? || battler.affection_level < 4 || battler.mega?
  629         next if pbRandom(100) < 80
  630         old_status = battler.status
  631         battler.pbCureStatus(false)
  632         case old_status
  633         when :SLEEP
  634           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} shook itself awake so you wouldn't worry!", battler.pbThis))
  635         when :POISON
  636           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} managed to expel the poison so you wouldn't worry!", battler.pbThis))
  637         when :BURN
  638           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} healed its burn with its sheer determination so you wouldn't worry!", battler.pbThis))
  639         when :PARALYSIS
  640           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} gathered all its energy to break through its paralysis so you wouldn't worry!", battler.pbThis))
  641         when :FROZEN
  642           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} melted the ice with its fiery determination so you wouldn't worry!", battler.pbThis))
  643         end
  644       end
  645     end
  646     # Healing from Aqua Ring, Ingrain, Leech Seed
  647     pbEORHealingEffects(priority)
  648     # Damage from Hyper Mode (Shadow Pokémon)
  649     priority.each do |battler|
  650       next if !battler.inHyperMode? || @choices[battler.index][0] != :UseMove
  651       hpLoss = battler.totalhp / 24
  652       @scene.pbDamageAnimation(battler)
  653       battler.pbReduceHP(hpLoss, false)
  654       pbDisplay(_INTL("The Hyper Mode attack hurts {1}!", battler.pbThis(true)))
  655       battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
  656     end
  657     # Damage from poison/burn
  658     pbEORStatusProblemDamage(priority)
  659     # Damage from Nightmare and Curse
  660     pbEOREffectDamage(priority)
  661     # Trapping attacks (Bind/Clamp/Fire Spin/Magma Storm/Sand Tomb/Whirlpool/Wrap)
  662     priority.each { |battler| pbEORTrappingDamage(battler) }
  663     # Octolock
  664     priority.each do |battler|
  665       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[PBEffects::Octolock] < 0
  666       pbCommonAnimation("Octolock", battler)
  667       battler.pbLowerStatStage(:DEFENSE, 1, nil) if battler.pbCanLowerStatStage?(:DEFENSE)
  668       battler.pbLowerStatStage(:SPECIAL_DEFENSE, 1, nil) if battler.pbCanLowerStatStage?(:SPECIAL_DEFENSE)
  669       battler.pbItemOnStatDropped
  670     end
  671     # Effects that apply to a battler that wear off after a number of rounds
  672     pbEOREndBattlerEffects(priority)
  673     # Check for end of battle (i.e. because of Perish Song)
  674     if @decision > 0
  675       pbGainExp
  676       return
  677     end
  678     # Effects that apply to a side that wear off after a number of rounds
  679     2.times { |side| pbEOREndSideEffects(side, priority) }
  680     # Effects that apply to the whole field that wear off after a number of rounds
  681     pbEOREndFieldEffects(priority)
  682     # End of terrains
  683     pbEOREndTerrain
  684     priority.each do |battler|
  685       # Self-inflicted effects that wear off after a number of rounds
  686       pbEOREndBattlerSelfEffects(battler)
  687       # Bad Dreams, Moody, Speed Boost
  688       if battler.abilityActive?
  689         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerEndOfRoundEffect(battler.ability, battler, self)
  690       end
  691       # Flame Orb, Sticky Barb, Toxic Orb
  692       if battler.itemActive?
  693         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerEndOfRoundEffect(battler.item, battler, self)
  694       end
  695       # Harvest, Pickup, Ball Fetch
  696       if battler.abilityActive?
  697         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerEndOfRoundGainItem(battler.ability, battler, self)
  698       end
  699     end
  700     pbGainExp
  701     return if @decision > 0
  702     # Form checks
  703     priority.each { |battler| battler.pbCheckForm(true) }
  704     # Switch Pokémon in if possible
  705     pbEORSwitch
  706     return if @decision > 0
  707     # In battles with at least one side of size 3+, move battlers around if none
  708     # are near to any foes
  709     pbEORShiftDistantBattlers
  710     # Try to make Trace work, check for end of primordial weather
  711     priority.each { |battler| battler.pbContinualAbilityChecks }
  712     # Reset/count down battler-specific effects (no messages)
  713     allBattlers.each do |battler|
  714       battler.effects[PBEffects::BanefulBunker]    = false
  715       battler.effects[PBEffects::Charge]           -= 1 if battler.effects[PBEffects::Charge] > 0
  716       battler.effects[PBEffects::Counter]          = -1
  717       battler.effects[PBEffects::CounterTarget]    = -1
  718       battler.effects[PBEffects::Electrify]        = false
  719       battler.effects[PBEffects::Endure]           = false
  720       battler.effects[PBEffects::FirstPledge]      = nil
  721       battler.effects[PBEffects::Flinch]           = false
  722       battler.effects[PBEffects::FocusPunch]       = false
  723       battler.effects[PBEffects::FollowMe]         = 0
  724       battler.effects[PBEffects::HelpingHand]      = false
  725       battler.effects[PBEffects::HyperBeam]        -= 1 if battler.effects[PBEffects::HyperBeam] > 0
  726       battler.effects[PBEffects::KingsShield]      = false
  727       battler.effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus]       -= 1 if battler.effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus] > 0
  728       if battler.effects[PBEffects::LockOn] > 0   # Also Mind Reader
  729         battler.effects[PBEffects::LockOn]         -= 1
  730         battler.effects[PBEffects::LockOnPos]      = -1 if battler.effects[PBEffects::LockOn] == 0
  731       end
  732       battler.effects[PBEffects::MagicBounce]      = false
  733       battler.effects[PBEffects::MagicCoat]        = false
  734       battler.effects[PBEffects::MirrorCoat]       = -1
  735       battler.effects[PBEffects::MirrorCoatTarget] = -1
  736       battler.effects[PBEffects::Obstruct]         = false
  737       battler.effects[PBEffects::Powder]           = false
  738       battler.effects[PBEffects::Prankster]        = false
  739       battler.effects[PBEffects::PriorityAbility]  = false
  740       battler.effects[PBEffects::PriorityItem]     = false
  741       battler.effects[PBEffects::Protect]          = false
  742       battler.effects[PBEffects::RagePowder]       = false
  743       battler.effects[PBEffects::Roost]            = false
  744       battler.effects[PBEffects::Snatch]           = 0
  745       battler.effects[PBEffects::SpikyShield]      = false
  746       battler.effects[PBEffects::Spotlight]        = 0

  748       battler.lastHPLost                           = 0
  749       battler.lastHPLostFromFoe                    = 0
  750       battler.droppedBelowHalfHP                   = false
  751       battler.statsDropped                         = false

  753       battler.tookDamageThisRound                  = false
  754       battler.tookPhysicalHit                      = false
  755       battler.statsRaisedThisRound                 = false
  756       battler.statsLoweredThisRound                = false
  757       battler.canRestoreIceFace                    = false
  758       battler.lastRoundMoveFailed                  = battler.lastMoveFailed
  759       battler.lastAttacker.clear
  760       battler.lastFoeAttacker.clear
  761     end
  762     # Reset/count down side-specific effects (no messages)
  763     2.times do |side|
  764       @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::CraftyShield]         = false
  765       if !@sides[side].effects[PBEffects::EchoedVoiceUsed]
  766         @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::EchoedVoiceCounter] = 0
  767       end
  768       @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::EchoedVoiceUsed]      = false
  769       @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::MatBlock]             = false
  770       @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::QuickGuard]           = false
  771       @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::Round]                = false
  772       @sides[side].effects[PBEffects::WideGuard]            = false
  773     end
  774     # Reset/count down field-specific effects (no messages)
  775     @field.effects[PBEffects::IonDeluge]   = false
  776     @field.effects[PBEffects::FairyLock]   -= 1 if @field.effects[PBEffects::FairyLock] > 0
